title: CAPM vs Google Project Management Certificate: Which Should a Beginner Get?
dek: For a complete beginner, start with the cheaper, gentler Google Certificate; add the CAPM for a recognized exam credential. And since the Google course counts toward CAPM's education requirement, many people do both.

body.richText: These are the two credentials almost every beginner in project management weighs first. Most articles pit them against each other, but the honest truth is they're not really rivals — they do different jobs, and they can work together.

Quick answer: the Google Certificate teaches you the fundamentals affordably; the CAPM is a recognized exam credential from PMI. If you're starting from zero, do the Google Certificate first — it even counts toward the CAPM's education requirement.

body.text: The key difference most people miss

body.richText: The Google Project Management Certificate is a course completion credential — you finish eight self-paced courses on Coursera and earn a certificate of learning. The CAPM is a professional certification: you pass a proctored exam administered by the Project Management Institute (PMI). One proves you studied; the other is a credential you hold.

body.richText: The overlap that makes them complementary: the Google Certificate provides project management education that counts toward the 23 contact hours the CAPM requires. So doing Google first doesn't compete with the CAPM — it feeds into it.

items: You're starting from zero and want the gentlest, cheapest on-ramp
You prefer self-paced video learning over exam prep
You want to test whether project management is right for you before committing more
You want a recognized certification (not just a course certificate) on your résumé
You're comfortable preparing for and sitting a proctored exam
You're aiming toward the PMP later — the CAPM is a natural stepping stone

body.richText: Who neither is for: people who already have real project experience and can qualify for the PMP. If that's you, skip both beginner options and go straight for the PMP.

richText: For most true beginners: do the Google Certificate first, then the CAPM. The Google course teaches you the basics and supplies education hours; the CAPM then validates your knowledge with a recognized exam. items.question: Should I get the Google certificate or the CAPM first?
items.answerRichText: For a complete beginner, the Google Certificate first — it's cheaper, teaches the fundamentals, and the education hours count toward the CAPM. Then add the CAPM when you want a recognized exam credential.

items.question: Is the Google Project Management Certificate the same as the CAPM?
items.answerRichText: No. The Google Certificate is a course completion credential from Coursera; the CAPM is a professional certification earned by passing a proctored PMI exam. They complement each other rather than being interchangeable.
